name: @hl-bos/hl-bti
description: HL-BTI — the deployable Herman Legacy Business Transformation application. An authenticated, statically-exported SPA that reuses HL-BOS identity/tenancy/permissions (Supabase) and the @hl-bos/bti-engine, persisting businesses and analyses to the HL-BOS Supabase Pro project via the public bti_* RPCs. Deployed to the Herman Legacy Cloud (Coolify).
